title: 'Too big to fail': why SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank must hold extra capital
short: Too big to fail: the RBI's 2026 list of India's most crucial banks
dek: On 23 November the RBI again named SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank as domestic systemically important banks. What the label means, how the buckets work, and what the extra capital costs.
card: SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank stay on the RBI's 'too big to fail' list. What the extra 0.20–0.80% capital rule means.
